claims.claim: Industrial gear box and electric motor
claims.evidence: Witness report describes a blue industrial motor/gearbox unit with an output shaft and flanged mounting.
Nameplate/label is visible but not fully readable; no horsepower/kW value is confirmed in the report.
Gear ratio/type is listed as not shown; label is not fully readable.
No import documents, serial trace, or fully readable plate confirming origin is shown in the witness report.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: Working condition (tested/functional), noise/vibration, and oil leaks are explicitly not shown; no test video/measurement is included.

risks.risk: Power rating (20hp) may be different from what’s claimed; wrong rating affects suitability and value.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the nameplate showing horsepower/kW, voltage, frequency, and RPM (or a readable model/spec sheet).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used industrial motor/gearbox with unknown rating (worst-case: treat as not confirmed specs).

risks.risk: Gear ratio may not be 1:10; wrong ratio changes output speed/torque.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the gearbox label/plate or any engraving showing gear ratio (e.g., 1:10) and gearbox type.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used gearbox with unknown ratio (worst-case: assume mismatch risk).

risks.risk: Not actually tested/working; internal faults may exist despite cosmetic condition.
risks.proof: Short video of it running under load (or at least powered-on) showing smooth operation/no abnormal noise, plus any current draw/temperature reading if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as for parts/repair until demonstrated).

risks.risk: Missing completeness: coupling, starter/controller, mounting hardware, or required accessories may be absent.
risks.proof: Photos showing what’s included: front/back, shaft end, coupling (if any), and all loose parts; plus a checklist of included items.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (worst-case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

risks.risk: Compatibility issues: voltage/frequency/RPM may not match Lagos supply or the buyer’s machine.
risks.proof: Readable nameplate showing voltage (e.g., 380/415V), frequency (50Hz), and RPM; plus shaft diameter measurement photo.
risks.if_unproven: Price as unknown electrical compatibility (worst-case: assume buyer may need rewiring/transformer).

risks.risk: Condition issues not visible: oil leaks, shaft seal wear, bearing noise, or damage to mounting surfaces.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seals, gearbox oil level/leak points, and mounting face; plus a running clip showing vibration/no leaks.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with potential wear (worst-case: assume possible leaks/maintenance needed).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the full nameplate/label (all text readable) showing horsepower/kW, voltage, frequency, and RPM.
Send a clear close-up of the gearbox plate/label showing the gear ratio (confirm 1:10) and gearbox model/type.
Provide a short video of the unit running (powered on) showing smooth operation/no knock and no oil leaks.
Show the shaft end and measure/photograph shaft diameter; confirm coupling type/size if included.
Confirm exactly what accessories are included (coupling, starter/controller, mounting bolts/hardware) with photos of everything in the package.
Provide serial number and model number from the nameplate (fully readable) for verification.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a used industrial motor/gearbox unit with a partially readable brand plate, but key pricing drivers (exact power rating, gear ratio, and verified working condition) are not readable or not shown. Without those proofs, any price would be guesswork.
